task_completion.description: The 8 cytochrome c sequences from the specified FASTA file are loaded into the UGENE interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: UGENE window showing 'cytochrome_c_multispecies.fasta' in the Project View or as an opened sequence object with 8 entries.

task_completion.description: The MUSCLE alignment algorithm is configured and run on the loaded sequences.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The MUSCLE alignment dialog box open or a progress bar indicating the alignment process is running.

task_completion.description: The aligned sequences are exported to the Stockholm (.sto) format at the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Export dialog showing the file path '~/UGENE_Data/results/cytc_alignment.sto' and the format selected as Stockholm.

task_completion.description: A search for the pattern 'C..CH' is performed within the alignment.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Search in Sequence' or 'Find Pattern' dialog showing the regex/pattern 'C..CH' entered.

task_completion.description: Matches found by the pattern search are annotated as 'heme_binding_site'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE sequence view showing annotations labeled 'heme_binding_site' on the sequences.

task_completion.description: The annotations are exported to a GFF file at the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Export dialog or file explorer showing 'cytc_heme_motifs.gff' being saved to '~/UGENE_Data/results/'.

task_completion.description: A text report is created containing sequence names, motif presence, coordinates, and a conclusion.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or UGENE internal viewer showing 'heme_motif_report.txt' with the required content (names, coordinates, and conservation conclusion).

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE graphical interface rather than just executing command-line scripts to generate files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the UGENE application window, menus, and dialog boxes being interacted with.

integrity.description: The motif search was actually performed on the data, not manually typed into a report.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of the 'C..CH' pattern being entered into UGENE's search/annotation tool.

integrity.description: The agent used the specific file paths and names requested in the task description.
integrity.visual_evidence: Save/Export dialogs showing the exact paths in the ~/UGENE_Data/results/ directory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The input file contains 8 UniProt Cytochrome c sequences. The motif 'C..CH' is a real conserved heme-binding motif present in all 8 sequences. The expected output files are cytc_alignment.sto, cytc_heme_motifs.gff, and heme_motif_report.txt. The motif typically appears around position 14-20 depending on the specific sequence alignment.
